sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 140. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Awakening. (Activates for 60 seconds when HP reaches 60% or below.)
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 140-Ability-Power attack that deals magic fire damage to all enemies 3 times by 100.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 50 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
[Unison Effect Boost] Target: all allies. Applies Awakening standby mode (Awakening is triggered when HP drops below 60% and continues for 60 seconds).
Only Glorious Tyrant Milim can be used as Unlocking Potential material
